children: FRE, the brand designed by nicotine users for nicotine users, and the premier creator-led gaming, entertainment, and lifestyle brand, 100 Thieves, today unveiled an exclusive, limited-edition line of collectible tins. The Vice Camo colorway headlines the collection, drawing inspiration from the electric energy of late nights in South Florida. The design will also be available in gunmetal and metallic silver colorways.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261119216499/en/

“100 Thieves has built its reputation in gaming, just as FRE has established its place in the pouch category,” said Connor Smith, VP of Brand & Marketing at Turning Point Brands. “With both brands rooted in Los Angeles, this partnership is built on a shared commitment to authenticity, performance, and standing out. This collaboration brings that mindset together in a product designed to make a statement and help you own your edge.”

Engineered from durable machined metal, the slim tin features engraved branding from both FRE and 100 Thieves. Built with an adjustable ratcheting mechanism and pocket-friendly profile, it is designed as an on-the-go companion to FRE’s 100-count Mega Pack. This makes reloading effortless and keeps pouches at peak freshness, allowing adult consumers to FRE themselves from compromise, wherever the night leads. Proudly made in America, the custom tin reflects a shared appreciation for quality craftsmanship and distinctive design.
Finished in a neon tropics colorway, each Vice Camo tin is hand-painted, so no two are the same, making each one a unique one-of-one collector’s item.

“We’ve always approached collaborations with the same creative mindset we bring to our apparel and everything else we design,” said Julie Van, President & COO at 100 Thieves. “Working with FRE gave us an opportunity to take something familiar and put an unexpected spin on it. The Vice Camo design has a personality of its own, and the fact that every piece is hand-painted makes it that much more distinctive.”

The FRE x 100 Thieves collectible tin line is now available to adults 21+ only while supplies last at frepouch.com, with the Vice Camo colorway at $99.99 and gunmetal and metallic silver colorways at $89.99. For more information on FRE, visit frepouch.com and on social media across Instagram and X.
FRE is owned and distributed by Turning Point Brands ($TPB /

), a manufacturer, marketer and distributor of branded consumer products. Designed by nicotine users for nicotine users, FRE was born out of a desire to push boundaries, confidently challenge old thinking, and provide adult nicotine users with a superior alternative to the dry, stale, and bland pouches you often find on the market. The result is a bold take on the white pouch experience, built for people who own their edge.
